name: World Championship 2027
overview: The 2027 World Championship (Worlds 2027) is the conclusion of the 2027 League of Legends esports season and the highest-prestige event in the competitive calendar. Organized by Riot Games, the tournament takes place in London, United Kingdom, from October 16 to November 7, 2027, with a total prize pool of USD 2,500,000. The qualified teams, format and schedule have not been announced.
